suggestion.description_commande: Suggest, view or manage the server's suggestions
suggestion.sous_encours: Marks a suggestion as in progress
suggestion.opt_salon: Channel to post suggestions in (empty to disable)
suggestion.sous_config_staff: Sets the role for the team handling suggestions
suggestion.opt_role: Role allowed to respond to suggestions (empty = Manage Messages)
suggestion.sous_config_fil: Enables or disables the discussion thread under each suggestion
suggestion.sous_config_niveau_min: Sets the minimum level required to suggest
suggestion.sous_config_delai: Sets the delay between two suggestions
suggestion.config_permission: You need the Manage Server permission to configure suggestions.
suggestion.config_salon_defini: Suggestions will now be posted in {salon}.
suggestion.config_salon_desactive: Suggestion system disabled: no channel is set anymore.
suggestion.config_staff_defaut: Only members with Manage Messages can handle suggestions.
suggestion.config_fil_actif: A discussion thread will be created under each new suggestion.
suggestion.config_fil_inactif: No more discussion threads will be created for new suggestions.
suggestion.config_niveau_aucun: No minimum level is required to suggest anymore.
suggestion.config_delai_aucun: No delay between two suggestions anymore.
suggestion.envoyer_desactive: The suggestion system isn't enabled on this server.
suggestion.envoyer_salon_introuvable: The suggestions channel can't be found. Let the team know.
suggestion.envoyer_niveau_requis: You need to be level **{n}** to suggest (you're level {niveau}).
suggestion.envoyer_delai: You still need to wait **{reste}** before sending another suggestion.
suggestion.staff_requis: You need to be part of the suggestion team to do that.

ticket.opt_salon_panneau: Channel to post the panel in (current channel by default)
ticket.sous_ajouter: Adds a member to the ticket
ticket.opt_membre_ajouter: Member to add to the ticket
ticket.sous_retirer: Removes a member from the ticket
ticket.opt_membre_retirer: Member to remove from the ticket
ticket.sous_config_categorie: Sets the category tickets are created in
ticket.opt_categorie: Category to create tickets in (empty = server root)
ticket.opt_role: Role allowed to manage tickets (empty = Manage Messages)
ticket.sous_config_logs: Sets the archive channel for closed tickets
ticket.opt_salon_logs: Channel to archive closed tickets in (empty = moderation logs)
ticket.sous_config_limite: Sets how many open tickets a member can have
ticket.opt_nombre: Maximum number of open tickets (0 = unlimited)
ticket.sous_config_formulaire: Enables or disables the opening form
ticket.opt_message: Panel message (\n for a line break)
ticket.config_permission: You need the Manage Server permission to configure tickets.
ticket.config_categorie_definie: Tickets will now be created in the **{categorie}** category.
ticket.config_categorie_racine: Tickets will now be created at the server root.
ticket.config_staff_aucun: Only members with Manage Messages can manage tickets.
ticket.config_logs_definis: Closed tickets will now be archived in {salon}.
ticket.config_logs_defaut: Closed tickets will now be archived in the moderation logs.
ticket.config_limite_definie: Limit set to **{n}** open tickets per member.
ticket.config_limite_illimitee: No more limit on open tickets per member.
ticket.config_panneau_texte_manque: Provide at least a title, a message or button text.
ticket.config_type_nom_invalide: That name doesn't produce a valid identifier, try another one.
ticket.config_type_max: 25 reasons maximum: remove one before adding another.
ticket.config_pied: The panel text is configured with `/ticket config panel-text`.
ticket.panneau_permission: You need the Manage Server permission to post the panel.
ticket.liste_vide: No tickets are open right now.
ticket.liste_pied_reste: {n} tickets in total — only the first 20 are shown above.
ticket.hors_ticket: This command only works inside an open ticket channel.
ticket.membre_ajoute: {membre} has been added to the ticket.
ticket.retrait_impossible: You can't remove the ticket's creator.
ticket.membre_retire: {membre} has been removed from the ticket.

vocal.description_commande: Manages your temporary voice channel and the server's hubs
vocal.sous_verrouiller: Locks your channel (no one else can join)
vocal.sous_cacher: Hides your channel from other members
vocal.sous_autoriser: Allows a member to join your channel
vocal.sous_expulser: Kicks a member from your channel
vocal.grp_config: Configures the temporary voice channel hubs
vocal.opt_hub_categorie: Category to create the hub in
vocal.opt_hub_places: Default slot count for created channels (0 = unlimited)
vocal.sous_config_lier_hub: Turns an existing channel into a hub
vocal.opt_lier_salon: Voice channel to turn into a hub
vocal.opt_lier_places: Default slot count for created channels (0 = unlimited)
vocal.sous_config_retirer_hub: Removes a channel from the hub list
vocal.sous_config_liste: Lists the hubs and active temporary channels
vocal.config_permission: You need the Manage Channels permission to configure temporary voice channels.
vocal.liste_variables_valeur: `{pseudo}` the member's name, `{numero}` the channel number
vocal.creer_hub_fait:
Hub created: {salon}. Channels created there will be named **{nom}**{places}.
{suite}
vocal.hors_salon: You need to be in a voice channel to do that.
vocal.pas_temporaire: This channel isn't a temporary voice channel.
vocal.expulsion_absent: That member isn't in the channel.
vocal.expulse: {membre} has been kicked from the channel.
vocal.transfert_absent: That member needs to be in the channel to become its owner.
vocal.raison_creer_hub: Temporary voice channel hub, created by {membre}
